verses.ar: فَكَفَّ هَؤُلَاءِ ٱلرِّجَالُ ٱلثَّلَاثَةُ عَنْ مُجَاوَبَةِ أَيُّوبَ لِكَوْنِهِ بَارًّا فِي عَيْنَيْ نَفْسِهِ.
verses.kjv: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he [was] righteous in his own eyes.
verses.web: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

verses.ar: فَحَمِيَ غَضَبُ أَلِيهُوَ بْنِ بَرَخْئِيلَ ٱلْبُوزِيِّ مِنْ عَشِيرَةِ رَامٍ. عَلَى أَيُّوبَ حَمِيَ غَضَبُهُ لأِنَّهُ حَسِبَ نَفْسَهُ أَبَرَّ مِنَ ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.web: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

verses.ar: وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ ٱلثَّلَاثَةِ حَمِيَ غَضَبُهُ، لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَجِدُوا جَوَابًا وَٱسْتَذْنَبُوا أَيُّوبَ.
verses.kjv: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and [yet] had condemned Job.
verses.web: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ أَلِيهُو قَدْ صَبَرَ عَلَى أَيُّوبَ بِٱلْكَلَامِ، لِأَنَّهُمْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْهُ أَيَّامًا.
verses.kjv: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they [were] elder than he.
verses.web: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَى أَلِيهُو أَنَّهُ لَا جَوَابَ فِي أَفْوَاهِ ٱلرِّجَالِ ٱلثَّلَاثَةِ حَمِيَ غَضَبُهُ.
verses.kjv: When Elihu saw that [there was] no answer in the mouth of [these] three men, then his wrath was kindled.
verses.web: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَلِيهُو بْنُ بَرَخْئِيلَ ٱلْبُوزِيُّ وَقَالَ: «أَنَا صَغِيرٌ فِي ٱلْأَيَّامِ وَأَنْتُمْ شُيُوخٌ، لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ خِفْتُ وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ أُبْدِيَ لَكُمْ رَأْيِيِ.
verses.kjv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I [am] young, and ye [are] very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
verses.web: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

verses.ar: قُلْتُ: ٱلْأَيَّامُ تَتَكَلَّمُ وَكَثْرَةُ ٱلسِّنِينِ تُظْهِرُ حِكْمَةً.
verses.kjv: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.web: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

verses.ar: وَلَكِنَّ فِي ٱلنَّاسِ رُوحًا، وَنَسَمَةُ ٱلْقَدِيرِ تُعَقِّلُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: But [there is] a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verses.web: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

verses.ar: لَيْسَ ٱلْكَثِيرُو ٱلْأَيَّامِ حُكَمَاءَ، وَلَا ٱلشُّيُوخُ يَفْهَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ.
verses.kjv: Great men are not [always] wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
verses.web: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ قُلْتُ: ٱسْمَعُونِي. أَنَا أَيْضًا أُبْدِي رَأْيِيِ.
verses.kjv: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.web: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

verses.ar: هَأَنَذَا قَدْ صَبَرْتُ لِكَلَامِكُمْ. أَصْغَيْتُ إِلَى حُجَجِكُمْ حَتَّى فَحَصْتُمُ ٱلْأَقْوَالَ.
verses.kjv: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.web: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

verses.ar: فَتَأَمَّلْتُ فِيكُمْ وَإِذْ لَيْسَ مَنْ حَجَّ أَيُّوبَ، وَلَا جَوَابَ مِنْكُمْ لِكَلَامِهِ.
verses.kjv: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, [there was] none of you that convinced Job, [or] that answered his words:
verses.web: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَقُولُوا: قَدْ وَجَدْنَا حِكْمَةً. ٱللهُ يَغْلِبُهُ لَا ٱلْإِنْسَانُ.
verses.kjv: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
verses.web: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يُوَجِّهْ إِلَيَّ كَلَامَهُ وَلَا أَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ أَنَا بِكَلَامِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Now he hath not directed [his] words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.web: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

verses.ar: تَحَيَّرُوا. لَمْ يُجِيبُوا بَعْدُ. ٱنْتَزَعَ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْكَلَامُ.
verses.kjv: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
verses.web: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

verses.ar: فَٱنْتَظَرْتُ لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمُوا. لِأَنَّهُمْ وَقَفُوا، لَمْ يُجِيبُوا بَعْدُ.
verses.kjv: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, [and] answered no more;)
verses.web: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

verses.ar: فَأُجِيبُ أَنَا أَيْضًا حِصَّتِي، وَأُبْدِي أَنَا أَيْضًا رَأْيِيِ.
verses.kjv: [I said], I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.web: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي مَلآنٌ أَقْوَالًا. رُوحُ بَاطِنِي تُضَايِقُنِي.
verses.kjv: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.web: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

verses.ar: هُوَذَا بَطْنِي كَخَمْرٍ لَمْ تُفْتَحْ. كَٱلزِّقَاقِ ٱلْجَدِيدَةِ يَكَادُ يَنْشَقُّ.
verses.kjv: Behold, my belly [is] as wine [which] hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
verses.web: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

verses.ar: أَتَكَلَّمُ فَأُفْرَجُ. أَفْتَحُ شَفَتَيَّ وَأُجِيبُ.
verses.kjv: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
verses.web: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

verses.ar: لَا أُحَابِيَنَّ وَجْهَ رَجُلٍ وَلَا أَمْلُثُ إِنْسَانًا.
verses.kjv: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
verses.web: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي لَا أَعْرِفُ ٱلْمَلْثَ. لِأَنَّهُ عَنْ قَلِيلٍ يَأْخُذُنِي صَانِعِي.
verses.kjv: For I know not to give flattering titles; [in so doing] my maker would soon take me away.
verses.web: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
